observation: After the validated tail-V2 repair, the four-window P8 B12X/NVFP4 mean KLD was 0.05156859723116893 versus 0.04839164 on the combined FP8-backend/FP8-KV control, leaving an approximately 6.6 percent directional residual under non-isolated systems.
decision_question: Do real conditional-fit writer inputs exceed the static 288-byte NoPE NVFP4 writer's E4M3 group-scale range, making the existing per-layer outer-scale bank an empirically supported calibration target?
primary_hypothesis: At least one attention layer has writer-domain group_amax greater than 6*448 on real conditional-fit traffic after its configured outer-scale divide.
rivals: The scale bank has adequate headroom and the remaining KLD is caused elsewhere.
Non-finite or padded graph rows create apparent exceedance unless excluded.
The observer changes execution or logits and its measurements are not admissible.
candidate: Tail-V2 runtime plus read-only NVFP4 MLA writer-input counter enabled.
control: The identical tail-V2 runtime with the counter disabled.
changed_variable: Read-only counter reductions and request-boundary receipts only; no writer, reader, scale file, model weight, cache byte, attention selection, or output arithmetic changes.

mandatory_integrity_gate.data_role: fit canary; it is not one of the 32 conditional-fit windows
mandatory_integrity_gate.procedure: Cold-start uninstrumented and instrumented arms with identical immutable identities, warm them identically, force the same token sequence, and capture every aligned FP32 pre-mask causal logit.
mandatory_integrity_gate.pass: Shapes, row identities, forced token IDs and SHA-256 of the complete raw FP32 logits are bit-identical between arms on every TP rank-reduced output.
mandatory_integrity_gate.failure: Stop; do not interpret counter receipts or run the conditional-fit panel. Preserve the failed canary and repair under a new protocol version.

panel.sampling: the already fixed domain-balanced panel; no substitution or exclusion
panel.execution: one request at a time under the production FULL CUDA-graph mode; graph capture registers counter reductions behind a zero device gate; reset is processed by the outer model-runner hook after warmup and before first replay; dump_reset at every request boundary; final dump before a disposable flush request

measurements.experimental_unit: conditional-fit window; TP/DCP ranks and layers are repeated subsamples, not independent units
per_layer_rank: saturated_groups and saturated_group_fraction, defined as requested E4M3 scale > 448
saturated_tokens and saturated_token_fraction, defined as any saturated group in a valid token
measurements.validity: Only slot IDs in [0,num_blocks*block_size) count; invalid CUDA-graph padding rows are excluded. Every rank receipt is required.
measurements.aggregation: Preserve every window/layer/rank row. Summarize maxima and fractions over windows without treating ranks, layers, groups, tokens, or values as independent repetitions.

decision_before_result.scale_range_exceedance_supported: Any valid saturated group with max_writer_amax_ratio > 1 and zero non-finite values supports the narrow claim that the current scale bank is too small for at least one observed conditional-fit group.
decision_before_result.scale_range_exceedance_not_observed: All 32 windows and all expected layer/rank receipts have max_writer_amax_ratio <= 1, zero saturated groups, and zero non-finite values.
decision_before_result.invalid: Any canary mismatch, missing window/layer/rank receipt, record width other than 288, non-finite writer input, role substitution, or silent retry invalidates this diagnostic.
decision_before_result.quality_boundary: Exceedance does not prove it explains KLD. A refit scale bank is a new candidate and requires its own frozen, uninstrumented KLD A/B.

performance_boundary: Instrumentation adds GPU reductions and host synchronization. No instrumented timing, prefill, decode, latency, throughput, or speed comparison is admissible; speed checks use the counter-disabled tail-V2 image.
storage: Receipts are small JSON only. No logits or large captures are written by the counter, and nothing is written to klcstore.
ldlq: N/A - attention KV scale diagnostic; does not modify the P8 encoder or ABI
